question: Which landmark Supreme Court judgment upheld the constitutional validity of the PMLA, 2002 in July 2022?
options: Nikesh Tarachand Shah vs Union of India
Vijay Madanlal Choudhary vs Union of India
P. Chidambaram vs Directorate of Enforcement
Binod Kumar vs State of Bihar
answer: Vijay Madanlal Choudhary vs Union of India
hint: अब तक PMLA पर सबसे व्यापक (comprehensive) फैसला (verdict)।
explanation: 2022 के इस judgment में, Supreme Court की तीन-जजों की बेंच ने PMLA के लगभग सभी challenged provisions को बरकरार रखा (upheld), जिसमें arrest की शक्तियां और bail के लिए twin conditions शामिल हैं।

question: In the Vijay Madanlal case, the Supreme Court ruled that the ECIR is NOT equivalent to an FIR. What does ECIR stand for?
answer: Enforcement Case Information Report
hint: FIR का ED का internal version।
explanation: Court ने माना कि ECIR एक internal document है और पुलिस FIR के विपरीत, ED को आरोपी (accused) को इसकी copy देना ज़रूरी नहीं है।

question: According to the Supreme Court in the Vijay Madanlal case, what happens if a person is acquitted of the 'Predicate Offence'?
options: The PMLA case also ceases to exist (no proceeds of crime)
The person must pay a fine to settle the PMLA case
The PMLA case is stayed for 10 years
answer: The PMLA case also ceases to exist (no proceeds of crime)
hint: कोई अपराध नहीं = कोई proceeds (आय) नहीं।
explanation: Court ने फैसला दिया कि यदि कोई 'scheduled offence' नहीं है, तो 'proceeds of crime' नहीं हो सकते। Proceeds of crime के बिना, money laundering का अपराध कायम (maintained) नहीं रखा जा सकता।

question: Regarding Section 50 of PMLA (Statements to ED), the Supreme Court held that these statements are admissible in evidence because:
options: Accused persons have no right to silence
Financial crimes are more serious than murder
The statements are recorded on video
answer: ED officers are not 'Police Officers'
hint: वे एक special act के तहत administrative/investigative officers हैं।
explanation: चूँकि ED officers को police officers नहीं माना जाता है, इसलिए custody में दिए गए बयानों (statements) के उपयोग पर लगी रोक (Evidence Act के अनुसार) Section 50 PMLA statements पर लागू नहीं होती है।

question: In the case of 'FIU-IND vs Paytm Payments Bank Limited (2024)', the penalty was primarily imposed for:
options: Failure to verify the identity of beneficiaries in certain payout services
answer: Failure to verify the identity of beneficiaries in certain payout services
hint: उचित CDD के बिना 'payout' services के माध्यम से काम करने से संबंधित।
explanation: FIU-IND ने beneficial owners की पहचान verify करने में विफलता और reporting के लिए internal mechanisms की कमी सहित कई उल्लंघनों के लिए Paytm Payments Bank पर 5.49 करोड़ रुपये का जुर्माना (fine) लगाया।

question: The case of 'FIU-IND vs Bybit Fintech Limited' relates to which category of entities?
answer: Virtual Digital Asset Service Providers (VASPs)
explanation: भारत में एक VASP के रूप में AML/CFT registration और reporting आवश्यकताओं का अनुपालन (comply) किए बिना काम करने के लिए FIU-IND द्वारा Bybit को एक show-cause notice और उसके बाद की कार्रवाई (action) जारी की गई थी।

question: What was the core violation in 'IFSCA vs Prowess Insurance Brokers Pvt. Ltd. (PIBPL)'?
options: Failure to appoint a Principal Officer and implement an AML policy
answer: Failure to appoint a Principal Officer and implement an AML policy
explanation: IFSCA ने आवश्यक AML/CFT framework स्थापित (establish) करने और Principal Officer जैसे statutory officers की नियुक्ति (appointing) में विफल रहने के लिए PIBPL के खिलाफ कार्रवाई की।

question: The action by FIU-IND against 'Way2Wealth Brokers Private Limited' involved which major violation?
options: Failure to report Suspicious Transactions (STRs) related to certain clients
Allowing cash deposits in demat accounts
answer: Failure to report Suspicious Transactions (STRs) related to certain clients
explanation: Broker को उन clients से जुड़ी suspicious activities का पता लगाने और report करने में विफल रहने के लिए दंडित (penalized) किया गया था जो regulatory या criminal investigation के अधीन थे।

question: In 'IFSCA vs Neo Asset Management Private Limited', the regulator focused on which aspect of the IFSCA 2022 Guidelines?
options: Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Risk Categorization
answer: Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Risk Categorization
explanation: इस मामले ने IFSC में asset managers के लिए गहन (thorough) CDD करने और अपने investors के लिए एक dynamic risk profile बनाए रखने की आवश्यकता पर प्रकाश डाला।

question: The 'Twin Conditions' for bail under Section 45 of PMLA require the court to be satisfied that:
options: The person is below 18 years of age
There are reasonable grounds to believe the person is NOT guilty and is unlikely to commit any offence while on bail
The person has a valid passport
The person has paid all taxes
answer: There are reasonable grounds to believe the person is NOT guilty and is unlikely to commit any offence while on bail
hint: Bail के उद्देश्य से निर्दोष (innocent) साबित होने तक दोषी (Guilty)।
explanation: Section 45 प्रभावी रूप से आरोपी (accused) पर bail पाने के लिए अपनी बेगुनाही (innocence) के बारे में अदालत को संतुष्ट करने का बोझ (burden) डालता है।

question: In the 'Pankaj Bansal vs Union of India' case (2023), the Supreme Court emphasized that the ED must provide:
options: A free lawyer to the accused
The grounds of arrest in writing to the accused
A copy of the investigation file
answer: The grounds of arrest in writing to the accused
hint: गिरफ्तारी (arrest) के समय लिखित कारण (Written reasons)।
explanation: Court ने फैसला दिया कि Section 19 के तहत 'inform' करने का मतलब है किसी व्यक्ति के संवैधानिक अधिकारों (constitutional rights) की रक्षा के लिए उसे गिरफ्तारी के आधार (grounds of arrest) लिखित में देना।

question: Case discussions involving 'Entry Operators' (like in Satyendar Jain vs ED) usually refer to persons who:
options: Operate bank entries for small businesses
Provide accommodation entries (converting cash to cheque for a commission)
Work as data entry clerks in the ED
answer: Provide accommodation entries (converting cash to cheque for a commission)
hint: Corporate accounts में नकद (cash) को clean करना (Laundering)।
explanation: Entry operators बिचौलिए (middlemen) होते हैं जो अवैध नकदी (illegal cash) लेते हैं और उसे साफ़ (clean) दिखाने के लिए कंपनियों में 'investment' या 'loans' के रूप में वापस कर देते हैं।

question: Which authority is responsible for hearing the review of the 'Vijay Madanlal' judgment?
options: A three-judge bench of the Supreme Court (currently under review)
answer: A three-judge bench of the Supreme Court (currently under review)
hint: यह सर्वोच्च न्यायालय (highest court) में ही रहता है।
explanation: 2022 के फैसले के खिलाफ कई review petitions दायर की गई हैं, जो 'proceeds of crime' और 'self-incrimination' की व्याख्या (interpretation) पर केंद्रित हैं।

question: In 'FIU-IND vs Binance' (and other offshore VASPs), the primary legal issue was:
options: Non-registration as a Reporting Entity under PMLA while serving Indian users
High transaction fees for Indian users
Using local languages on their app
answer: Non-registration as a Reporting Entity under PMLA while serving Indian users
hint: Offshore entities को स्थानीय ग्राहकों को सेवा देते समय स्थानीय AML कानून का पालन करना चाहिए।
explanation: FIU-IND ने जोर देकर कहा कि भारतीयों को सेवाएं प्रदान करने वाले किसी भी VASP को PMLA के तहत register करना और उसका अनुपालन (comply) करना चाहिए, चाहे उनकी physical location कोई भी हो।

question: The concept of 'Continuing Offence' in PMLA cases means:
options: The crime starts when the predicate offence happens and continues until the money is clean
A person can be charged multiple times for the same act
Laundering money as long as it is in possession
answer: Laundering money as long as it is in possession
explanation: अदालतों ने माना है कि जब तक कोई व्यक्ति 'proceeds of crime' के कब्जे (possession) में है, तब तक वह money laundering का अपराध कर रहा है।

question: In 'Senthil Balaji vs State', the court clarified the ED's power regarding:
options: Custodial interrogation of an arrested person
Right to search a person's home
answer: Custodial interrogation of an arrested person
explanation: Supreme Court ने पुष्टि की कि ED गिरफ्तारी की तारीख से 15 दिनों के लिए किसी आरोपी की पुलिस हिरासत (police custody / interrogation) की मांग कर सकती है।

question: The 'Reverse Burden of Proof' (Section 24) upheld in court means:
options: The accused must prove that the proceeds of crime are untainted
The court must assume everyone is innocent
The bank must prove the client is a criminal
answer: The accused must prove that the proceeds of crime are untainted
hint: आरोपी (Accused) को खुद को बेदाग साबित करना होता है।
explanation: PMLA के तहत, एक बार जब अभियोजन (prosecution) proceeds of crime के अस्तित्व को साबित कर देता है, तो यह साबित करने का बोझ (burden) आरोपी पर आ जाता है कि संपत्ति दागी (tainted) नहीं है।

question: In the case of 'PIBPL', the IFSCA highlighted that 'Training' for employees should be:
options: Continuous and include awareness of AML/CFT trends
Optional and based on employee interest
answer: Continuous and include awareness of AML/CFT trends
explanation: IFSC के भीतर नियामक कार्रवाइयों (regulatory actions) में staff training की कमी को compliance विफलता (failure) के रूप में देखा गया था।

question: The case against 'Paytm Payments Bank' (2024) highlighted the abuse of which specific payment channel for laundering?
options: Illegal gambling and fraudulent apps using the 'Payout' APIs
answer: Illegal gambling and fraudulent apps using the 'Payout' APIs
explanation: जाँच (Investigations) से पता चला कि अवैध (illegal) online gambling में शामिल entities ने पर्याप्त KYC के बिना विजेताओं/एजेंटों को धन (funds) वितरित करने के लिए Paytm की payout services का उपयोग किया।

question: When the Adjudicating Authority (AA) confirms an attachment of property, can it be challenged?
options: Yes, by filing an appeal with the PMLA Appellate Tribunal
Yes, by writing to the Prime Minister
answer: Yes, by filing an appeal with the PMLA Appellate Tribunal
hint: PMLA अपीलों के लिए विशेष न्यायाधिकरण (specialized tribunal)।
explanation: AA के आदेशों के खिलाफ 45 दिनों के भीतर Appellate Tribunal में अपील (appeal) की जा सकती है।

question: In 'FIU-IND vs Way2Wealth', the FIU found that the broker failed to report STRs despite:
options: The client being arrested in a massive scam
The client moving to a different city
answer: The client being arrested in a massive scam
hint: सार्वजनिक रूप से ज्ञात suspicious activity।
explanation: किसी बड़े financial crime के लिए client के गिरफ्तार होने के बाद भी STR file करने में विफलता को एक गंभीर compliance विफलता माना गया।

question: Case law discussions on 'Search and Seizure' (Section 17) confirm that the ED can:
options: Search any premises without any reason
Search only after recording 'Reasons to Believe' in writing
answer: Search only after recording 'Reasons to Believe' in writing
explanation: किसी अधिकारी द्वारा search या seizure करने से पहले लिखित में 'Reasons to Believe' दर्ज करना एक अनिवार्य सुरक्षा उपाय (mandatory safeguard) है।

question: In 'Vijay Madanlal', the Supreme Court ruled that 'Money Laundering' is NOT limited to just the 'final act' of laundering, but covers:
options: Any process or activity connected with proceeds of crime
Only if foreign currency is involved
answer: Any process or activity connected with proceeds of crime
explanation: Section 3 के तहत परिभाषा में proceeds of crime को छिपाना (concealment), कब्ज़ा (possession), अधिग्रहण (acquisition) या उसका उपयोग शामिल है।

question: In 'Neo Asset Management', the IFSCA emphasized that 'Ongoing Monitoring' means:
options: Checking the client once a year
Real-time or periodic scrutiny of transactions and consistency with the client profile
Asking the client for a new photo every month
answer: Real-time or periodic scrutiny of transactions and consistency with the client profile
explanation: Ongoing monitoring यह सुनिश्चित करती है कि fund का उपयोग investor के घोषित उद्देश्य (declared purpose) और व्यवसाय से मेल खाता है।

question: In 'DA Paul vs Union of India', the court clarified that PMLA is:
options: A law that applies only to acts after 2005
Applicable to the 'continuing' act of laundering even if the original crime was before 2005
answer: Applicable to the 'continuing' act of laundering even if the original crime was before 2005
hint: पुराने गंदे पैसे का कब्ज़ा (Possession) वर्तमान में एक अपराध है।
explanation: यदि आपके पास आज proceeds of crime हैं, तो आप आज money laundering कर रहे हैं, भले ही मूल अपराध (original crime) कभी भी हुआ हो।

question: What is the primary role of the Adjudicating Authority in cases of property attachment?
options: To decide if the attachment of property as proceeds of crime should be made final
To prosecute the suspect in a special court
To return the property to the bank
answer: To decide if the attachment of property as proceeds of crime should be made final
explanation: AA, ED के provisional attachment की समीक्षा करता है और यह तय करता है कि क्या इसे (ट्रायल के दौरान) आगे की अवधि के लिए confirmed किया जाना चाहिए।

question: In 'FIU-IND vs Paytm', the fine was specifically linked to which rule of the PMLA Rules, 2005?
answer: All of the above
explanation: उल्लंघनों (Violations) में recording, reporting, और identification के कर्तव्य शामिल थे।

question: The 'V-CIP' norms discussed in recent cases were introduced to enable:
answer: Video-based remote customer identification
explanation: V-CIP, AML standards के अनुपालन में सुरक्षित, non-face-to-face onboarding की अनुमति देता है।

question: In the 'Bybit' case, FIU-IND directed the Ministry of Electronics and IT (MeitY) to:
options: Block the website/app for users in India
Lower the internet speed for Bybit users
answer: Block the website/app for users in India
explanation: PMLA registration का अनुपालन न करने पर, FIU ने offshore VASP platforms तक पहुंच (access) को ब्लॉक करने की सिफारिश की।

question: In 'IFSCA vs PIBPL', the lack of which internal policy was a major factor in the penalty?
answer: AML / CFT Policy
explanation: प्रत्येक Regulated Entity के पास एक Board-approved AML/CFT policy दस्तावेज़ होना चाहिए।

question: When a special court hears a PMLA case, the 'standard of proof' for conviction is:
options: Based on the officer's gut feeling
answer: Beyond reasonable doubt
explanation: जबकि bail/attachment के लिए सबूत का भार (burden of proof) बदल जाता है, लेकिन criminal trial में अंतिम दोषसिद्धि (final conviction) के लिए 'beyond reasonable doubt' (उचित संदेह से परे) सबूत की आवश्यकता होती है।

question: In 'Vijay Madanlal', the court clarified that 'Projecting property as untainted' is:
options: The only way to commit money laundering
Just one of several ways (Concealment, possession etc. are also enough)
answer: Just one of several ways (Concealment, possession etc. are also enough)
explanation: Court ने माना कि proceeds of crime का केवल कब्ज़ा (possession) या उपयोग भी money laundering माना जाता है।

question: The case 'Way2Wealth Brokers' serves as a reminder that Reporting Entities must monitor:
options: News and regulatory orders regarding their clients (Adverse Media)
answer: News and regulatory orders regarding their clients (Adverse Media)
explanation: Brokers को suspicious patterns का पता लगाने के लिए 'Adverse Media' और regulatory lists के खिलाफ clients की जाँच (screen) करनी चाहिए।

question: In PMLA cases, can an 'Intermediary' be held liable for not reporting a suspicious transaction?
options: No, only the customer is liable
Only if they helped the customer
Only if they are a government bank
answer: Yes, under Section 13 (Monetary Penalties)
explanation: Reporting entities (banks, brokers, आदि) को records maintain करने या transactions को report करने में विफल रहने पर भारी जुर्माने (heavy fines) का सामना करना पड़ता है।

question: In 'Satyendar Kumar Jain vs ED', the main allegation involved using 'Shell Companies' for:
options: Receiving accommodation entries to launder cash into share capital
answer: Receiving accommodation entries to launder cash into share capital
explanation: इस मामले में कोलकाता स्थित entry operators के माध्यम से नकदी (cash) को 'वैध' (legitimate) share capital में बदलना शामिल था।

question: The 'Beneficial Owner' identification process discussed in 'Neo Asset Management' is meant to:
options: Find out who is really investing the money
answer: Find out who is really investing the money
explanation: BO identification अपराधियों को जटिल (complex) corporate structures के पीछे छिपने से रोकता है।

question: Under the 'Vijay Madanlal' ruling, the ED can provisionally attach property for:
answer: 180 days
explanation: Section 5 के तहत एक provisional attachment order 180 दिनों के लिए वैध (valid) होता है।

question: In 'FIU-IND vs Bybit', the VASP was required to appoint a specific officer. Who is it?
answer: Principal Officer
explanation: प्रत्येक Reporting Entity को PMLA compliance के लिए एक Principal Officer नियुक्त करना अनिवार्य है।

question: Does the PMLA apply to transactions involving 'Cryptocurrency' according to recent cases?
options: Yes, since the 2023 notification brought VASPs under PMLA
Only if the transaction is above Rs. 1 Crore
answer: Yes, since the 2023 notification brought VASPs under PMLA
hint: VDA service providers अब reporting entities हैं।
explanation: सरकार ने मार्च 2023 में अधिसूचित (notified) किया कि Virtual Digital Assets से जुड़ी गतिविधियाँ PMLA के अंतर्गत आती हैं।

question: The 'PMLA Appellate Tribunal' is located in:
answer: New Delhi
explanation: Appellate Tribunal की Principal Bench नई दिल्ली (New Delhi) में स्थित है।

question: In 'PIBPL', the IFSCA emphasized that 'Risk Management' includes:
options: Identifying, assessing, and mitigating ML/TF risks
answer: Identifying, assessing, and mitigating ML/TF risks
explanation: IFSC में सभी regulated entities के लिए risk-based approach अनिवार्य है।

question: In 'FIU-IND vs Paytm', the lack of 'Beneficial Owner' identification was critical because it involved:
options: Merchants using payout services for illegal apps
answer: Merchants using payout services for illegal apps
explanation: Payout accounts का इस्तेमाल गुमनाम (anonymous) ऑपरेटरों द्वारा अवैध (illegal) gambling के पैसे को स्थानांतरित (move) करने के लिए किया जा रहा था।

question: A 'Special Court' under PMLA is designated by:
options: The Central Government in consultation with the Chief Justice of the High Court
answer: The Central Government in consultation with the Chief Justice of the High Court
hint: एक न्यायिक और कार्यकारी सहयोग (A judicial and executive collaboration)।
explanation: Section 43 Central Government को High Court के Chief Justice के परामर्श से Sessions Courts को PMLA के लिए Special Courts के रूप में नामित (designate) करने का अधिकार देता है।

question: Can a statement made to the ED be retracted later by the person?
options: Yes, but the court will decide the evidentiary value of such retraction
Yes, and the old statement is automatically deleted
answer: Yes, but the court will decide the evidentiary value of such retraction
hint: मुकरना (Retractions) आम है लेकिन उसकी जाँच (scrutinized) की जाती है।
explanation: कई आरोपी दबाव (coercion) का दावा करते हुए बयानों से मुकर जाते हैं, लेकिन Court यह मूल्यांकन (evaluates) करता है कि क्या मुकरना एक बाद की सोच (afterthought) है।

question: In 'Way2Wealth', the penalty was imposed under which section of the PMLA?
answer: Section 13
hint: Reporting entities पर प्रशासनिक जुर्माने (administrative fines) के लिए सेक्शन।
explanation: Section 13 Director (FIU) को compliance विफलताओं के लिए जुर्माना (fines) लगाने की शक्ति देता है।

question: The 'Travel Rule' discussed in VASP related cases requires exchanges to:
options: Share sender and receiver information for crypto transfers
Report if a customer goes abroad
answer: Share sender and receiver information for crypto transfers
explanation: Travel Rule यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि digital assets के 'गुमनाम' (anonymous) transfers को कम से कम किया जाए।

question: In 'Neo Asset Management', the 'Senior Management Approval' was discussed for which category?
answer: High Risk / PEPs
hint: जोखिम वाले clients के लिए अतिरिक्त निगरानी (Extra oversight)।
